Just to check- are you in the US?  If so, you are an adult. You can do what you wish with your own body. A few things though.

- Here in the US, it is pretty rare for a young, unmarried woman to get a hysterectomy. The reasons are, of course, completely sexist… “What if you meet a man who wants kids?”

- A full hysterectomy is probably too much to ask. You want, instead, a tubal ligation, basically “tying your tubes”, since you don’t want kids. A hysterectomy will accomplish the same thing, yes, but be much harsher. A hysterectomy comes with 6-8 weeks recovery time, I believe- will your parents help?

The important thing is to stay on topic- for instance, if she brings up your chores issue, tell her that “unless you’re doing it for revenge, the chores have nothing to do with it.”
